entities.name: Anax
entities.description: A fifteen-year-old prince of Akros who decides to compete in the pankration, trains with Kaletor and Zotikos, and outmaneuvers his brother Timoteus.

entities.name: Timoteus
entities.description: Anax's older brother, a prince trained by Sinon, who tries to cripple Anax in the pankration and is whipped for it.

entities.name: Sinon
entities.description: A hairless, muscular three-time champion of the pankration who refuses to train Anax and trains Timoteus; he once crippled Kaletor.

entities.name: Zotikos
entities.description: Anax's friend, an older boy who trains with him at the gymnasium each evening.

entities.name: Georgios
entities.description: Anax's elderly teacher, who recommends Kaletor and challenges Anax's reasoning.

entities.name: Kaletor
entities.description: One of the king's advisors, a former pankration competitor crippled in the knee, who becomes Anax's trainer.

entities.name: King Athanas
entities.description: The king of Akros and father of Anax and Timoteus, furious at Timoteus's attempt to cripple his brother.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: A young woman from a powerful family who is being considered as Anax's future wife.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god whose visit would signal victory.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The city-state ruled by King Athanas.

entities.name: Kolophon
entities.description: The place where the royal family lives and where Sinon's estate lies at its edge.

events.summary: Anax visits the champion Sinon and asks to train with him for the Games, but Sinon refuses since he already trains Timoteus.
events.quote: I only have time for one pupil.

events.summary: Anax and Zotikos spar at the gymnasium; Zotikos beats him with an arm lock but cannot explain how.
events.quote: "Maybe I could help. Let's get everything out of the middle."

events.summary: Georgios suggests the advisor Kaletor, a former pankration competitor, as a teacher.
events.quote: He competed in the pankration for several years.

events.summary: Anax asks Kaletor to train him; learning Sinon trains his brother, Kaletor agrees with fire in his eyes.
events.quote: "In that case, I will be honored to help you."

events.summary: Kaletor begins training Anax and Zotikos at night, teaching Anax to close and ground opponents and to use joint locks.
events.quote: Kaletor was true to his word, and began to teach Anax and Zotikos that very night.

events.summary: Anax nearly cripples Zotikos with a kneebar and Kaletor confirms Sinon crippled him that way.
Kaletor teaches the heel hook and makes Anax promise not to hurt anyone with it.
events.quote: Promise me you won't hurt anyone with it.

events.summary: Anax wins his first two bouts of the junior pankration division before a packed stadium.
events.quote: Anax's first two bouts were easy.

events.summary: Anax draws Timoteus, who opens with strikes; Anax closes and takes him to the ground.
events.quote: He grabbed his brother's kicking thigh and opposite shoulder and shoved, and like that the two were on the ground.

events.summary: Anax baits Timoteus into the kneebar that crippled Kaletor, reverses it into a heel hook, and Timoteus submits.
events.quote: Timoteus went for it without a second thought.

events.summary: Anax publicly rebukes Timoteus for trying to cripple him, winning the crowd's respect.
events.quote: But who would want to serve a king who crippled his own brother?

events.summary: Anax loses his next bout but has won the crowd's respect.
events.quote: He lost his next bout to a tall young man who was about to come of age, and was stronger and more skilled.

events.summary: Timoteus is publicly whipped for treason for trying to cripple his future king.
events.quote: King Athanas was furious with his second son, and had insisted.

events.summary: The king tells Anax a marriage to Cymede is being arranged.
events.quote: We are considering a young woman named Cymede.

relations.note: Kaletor trains Anax for the pankration.
relations.quote: Kaletor was true to his word, and began to teach Anax and Zotikos that very night.
"Sinon is already teaching my brother, and he won't take another pupil."
Anax regarded his brother with contempt.
I train with one of my friends every evening at the gymnasium.

relations.note: Sinon crippled Kaletor's knee, a memory Kaletor finds unpleasant.
He is the king; his rule includes Akroan treason laws.
relations.quote: This punishment was a liberal interpretation of Akroan treason laws, but King Athanas was furious with his second son, and had insisted.
